name: Katakoi Visionary
source:
The protagonist is downloading an eroge on his PC. Suddenly, lightning strikes, and the heroine from the eroge jumps out of the computer screen. She claims her goal is to make the player=protagonist happy.

[Translated from [url=http://cotton-soft.com/gameproducts/09_KatakoiVisionary/page02.html]The Official website[/url]]
translation:
主角正在電腦上下載一款色情遊戲。突然，閃電擊中電腦，色情遊戲裡的女主角跳出螢幕。她聲稱自己的目標是讓玩家，也就是主角，獲得幸福。
